cases.note: A polite chaser: keep who, what, when and the ask.
cases.text: Hi Sarah, I hope you are doing well and that you had a great weekend. I am writing to follow up on the invoice that we sent over at the beginning of March, which as far as I can tell has not yet been paid. I completely understand that things get busy, but I would really appreciate it if you could take a look at it and let me know when we can expect payment. Thanks so much in advance for your help with this.

cases.note: A launch post: first person, the product and the claim must survive.
cases.text: I am really excited to finally be able to share something that I have been working on in the evenings for the last couple of months. It is called Timbre, and it is a small Mac app that lets you dictate into any application, and the thing that I think makes it genuinely different from everything else out there is that absolutely nothing you say ever leaves your computer, because all of the speech recognition and all of the cleanup runs entirely on your own machine.
The meter shows the RMS level of the audio.
